scope: Plan review only; no corpus/oracle/harness preflight, runtime verification, final artifact acceptance, gate advancement or publication authorization.
positive_findings: Explicit evaluation-only cross-source prototype separates source indexing, owner questions and packets from frozen shipped Waygrain capabilities.
Shared original sources, actual owner replies and reduced observations make the control a defensible marginal-organization comparator; no from-zero superiority claim.
Attribution distinguishes documented intent, simulated human reports, observed UI and unknown backend/production facts.
G07 verified closure is recorded in tasks/todo.md and its final-document-review.json; failed gates and G01-G07 historical evidence remain preserved.
Codex-only/synthetic variance limitations, Claude/Cursor deferrals, private candidate, public HOLD and no production implementation/publication remain explicit.

required_findings.title: Define study-agent isolation from answer-bearing planning and oracle material
required_findings.problem: The plan itself reveals intended answers, conflicts and missing approval policy. Hidden oracle and shell-disabled ephemeral sessions do not expressly prevent this plan, question/oracle files, parent context or fixture implementation from reaching agents through initial prompts, inherited instructions, filesystem access or study MCP search/read endpoints. Investigation question exposure is also undefined, which can turn broad investigation into advance answer preparation.
required_findings.change: Require fresh non-inherited study contexts and allowlisted source/owner/browser/packet surfaces. Exclude this plan, oracle, scoring rules, fixture internals and reviewer records from study-agent reads/tool results. State whether the investigator sees the ten downstream questions; for general future-work claims withhold them. Require preflight to inspect prompts and endpoints for leakage; keep owner answers narrowly topic-bound.

required_findings.title: Freeze executable scoring and comparison rules before smoke
required_findings.problem: Quality success, no regression and the 20-percent descriptive criterion lack fixed aggregation/denominator rules. Nine shared-investigation pairs and ten correlated answers per batch can support materially different verdicts depending on whether results are pooled, world-weighted, paired or filtered after failures. Source-grounding also needs an explicit inherited-packet evidence chain.
required_findings.change: In the preflight protocol freeze per-answer and per-investigation rubric, critical false-certainty/unsafe-action rules, absolute quality success threshold, no-regression aggregation, time/token aggregation and missing-usage/timeout treatment. Report all allocated denominators and per-world/pair distributions without treating 180 correlated answers as independent trials. Define packet grounding as packet claim plus the originating investigator exposure and qualifying source/owner/observation; reading an unsupported packet claim alone cannot ground it. Bind independent semantic reviews to exact packet/answer/exposure hashes.

required_findings.title: Specify failed-investigation propagation and identical evidence transfer
required_findings.problem: The plan requires 27 actual sessions with no retries but does not say whether downstream pairs still run after investigator timeout, missing/invalid packet or partial observations. Dropping such pairs would select successful investigations and change the comparator. Equal access to reduced observations and owner replies also needs a fixed transfer rule rather than author curation.
required_findings.change: Predeclare that all nine downstream pairs remain allocated, how empty/partial/invalid packets are represented, and how shared actual owner replies/observations are transferred without manual repair or injected resolution. Use identical hashed shared-evidence bundles and comparable search/read budgets/interfaces; failed investigators remain failures and cannot be silently replaced. Freeze handling of a work-arm infrastructure failure and benefit claims when paired data are incomplete.

optional_findings.title: Clarify safe exploration and cancellation evidence
optional_findings.detail: List the bounded browser routes/actions and authoritative observation fields in preflight. A close/cancel UI observation must remain distinct from proving that no backend write occurred, even when fixture code can reveal the implementation.

optional_findings.title: Avoid overclaiming independent worlds
optional_findings.detail: Three variants with a common admin-policy core provide bounded synthetic variance; report this dependence and the small nine-pair sample alongside descriptive benefit.

changes_made: Only this independent review receipt; plan and implementation untouched.
